sourceChecks.title: Dickey, “Time out of tense: Russian aspect in the imperative”
sourceChecks.finding: Examines affirmative and negated imperatives and argues for pragmatic/contextual aspectual distinctions; the abstract alone does not verify each example in the entry.

sourceChecks.title: Cornell University, Prepositions, Conjunctions, and Negation
sourceChecks.finding: Explains particle negation and scope movement examples, not aspect selection in every negative imperative.

sourceChecks.title: Canadian Journal of Linguistics, Negative Concord and locality in Russian
sourceChecks.finding: Explains ni-pronoun licensing with preverbal ne, negative concord, locality and scope limits; the theoretical study does not map every example in the entry.
